objective: Define a deterministic canonical acquisition-to-order funnel from ANA behavioral events and ORD order.requested facts using only explicit linkage keys, without identity stitching or temporal heuristics.

rootCause.projectionGap: ANA-A02/A03 define and ingest canonical behavioral stages, but there is no canonical funnel projector that composes them with ORD transactional handoff.
rootCause.authorityGap: Legacy service/quote funnel events must remain shadow inputs and cannot become a second analytics authority.
rootCause.linkageRisk: A funnel assembled by actor identity, timestamp proximity or cross-session heuristics would violate the A03 identity boundary and could falsely attribute anonymous behavior.

linkageAuthority.quoteJourney: quote_session_id within the same session/service journey
linkageAuthority.transactionalHandoff: quote.submitted.order_id joined to canonical ORD order.requested

metrics.numerator: unique search_request_id+service_id clicks with matching impression
strict session/service journeys reaching detail after click
strict journeys reaching budget CTA after detail
strict journeys with explicit quote_session_id started
strict journeys with same quote session completed
strict journeys with same quote session submitted and explicit order_id
strict submitted journeys whose order_id exists as canonical ORD order.requested

invariants: All events after dataThrough are excluded.
Search CTR deduplicates on explicit search_request_id + service_id exposure identity.
Strict funnel progression is scoped to analytics_session_id + service_id only; no cross-session reconstruction is allowed.
Quote progression requires the same explicit quote_session_id.
The behavior-to-transaction handoff requires quote.submitted.order_id and canonical ORD order.requested; order linkage is never inferred from actor or time proximity.
A later stage missing an earlier explicit stage is recorded as orphan evidence rather than backfilling the missing stage.
Zero denominator returns null, never zero percent.
Behavioral and transactional source authorities remain distinct.
Current behavior ledger does not carry immutable category/state cohort dimensions, so category/state funnel segmentation is not fabricated.
activationRequirements: forward-only runtime implementation of ANA-A07 behavior/ORD watermarks after explicit staging authorization
server-side funnel projection over private.analytics_behavior_events_v1 and private.order_metric_events
source filtering by received_at/created_at materialization boundaries plus canonical occurred_at event boundaries
metric-specific A07 freshness threshold policies for the funnel metrics being activated
controlled staging evidence for complete, orphan, empty-window and late-materialized stage paths
explicit immutable segmentation authority before category/state funnel claims

catLiquidityBlocker.evidence: ANA-A10/A11 now own and operationally certify CAT liquidity, publication cadence, freshness policy and scheduler runtime in staging.
catLiquidityBlocker.consequence: Liquidity is no longer an A09 blocker. A09 remains blocked on its own behavior/ORD dependency watermarks, server-side funnel projector, funnel freshness thresholds and controlled staging evidence.
catLiquidityBlocker.requiredHandoff: ANA-A07 behavior/ORD watermark runtime -> ANA-A09 funnel runtime

preservedBoundaries: Product Analytics remains distinct from operational observability.
ORD remains canonical for order.requested facts.
CAT remains canonical for service visibility facts.
Browser analytics remains disabled by default.
LEGAL-B03 remains authoritative for privacy and identity lifecycle.
PAY-backed metrics remain unavailable until PAY authority is canonical.

maturity.reason: A09 funnel semantics and the A07 behavior/ORD watermark runtime candidate are repository-ready. The migration, staging concurrency evidence, server-side funnel projector and metric-specific funnel freshness thresholds remain unapplied; ANA stays 3/6.
